metadata.question: What is Spotify's monthly active user count?

response.summary:
As of December 31, 2025, Spotify's monthly active user (MAU) count is 751 million. This represents an 11% increase from the previous year.

Sources:
- [Source 1: Spotify Annual Report 20-F (p.45)]
- [Source 2: Spotify Annual Report 20-F (p.49)]
- [Source 4: Spotify Annual Report 20-F (p.37)]
